In an IFS framework, we understand that every part has a positive intention, even if its actions—like pulling away from work—lead to difficult feelings later. When you feel this "shutdown" happening, I invite you to see if you can "find" it in, on, or around your body. This process is a way of getting to know the part rather than just being taken over by it.

As you stay with this part, we can gently wonder what it might be afraid would happen if it *didn't* shut everything down. Protective parts often carry fears that if they stop their job, the internal system will be overwhelmed by even more painful feelings or wounds from the past. Approaching this part with curiosity and gratitude for its hard work can help it feel safe enough to share more about what it is trying to do for you.
